highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 refreshes Skia m150 with upstream GPU and SkSL correctness fixes.
highlights_body: The bundled engine corrects stale readbacks, failed-flush tracking, Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion, and a SkSL RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free.

bullets.lead: Skia m150 receives four upstream bug-fix syncs
bullets.detail: Ganesh now handles failed flushes without stale readbacks or inconsistent dirty tracking, corrects Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion, and fixes a SkSL RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp package from 14.2.1.1 to 14.2.1.2.
